title: Second reel: more hometown band members
summary: After the tape change Robinson adds Dee Dee Taylor, a clarinetist, and notes no saxophone then.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: The tape ran off on the first reel. This is the second reel we're doing now of you and Jim Robinson. You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape.
What's his name? Dee Dee Taylor.
He was saying drums. Bass drums.
Bass drums. Who else was in that band? We got it pretty well, didn't we now? Yeah. You have a clarinet? Did you name a clarinet?
Yeah, you had a clarinet with Willie Davis.
No, no. There was no sax.
Why didn't they have saxophone? There wasn't saxophone at the time then.
Uh huh. Did any of those guys come to the city here and play any jazz?

I remember once they came on the labor's day and play the parade. Play the parade on the labor's day. Uh huh. And I was young for the day, you know. I couldn't come to town myself. I was looking. All the grown people, they came, you know. Uh huh.
